//: THE EMULATOR SUITE'S PORT TABLE — the one source. Read by emulator-ports.ts (the generator: firebase.json, the dev declaration, the devcontainer) and projected into the owned tools/emulator-ports.mjs (the runtime: emulators.sh, reap-emulators.sh, build-seeds.sh). defaults: firebase-tools' own port per emulator. alwaysOn: infrastructure a running suite always occupies (pinned, shifted, even when firebase.json is silent). nested: ports an emulator declares under a key of its own — occupied and shifted only when declared (undeclared, firebase-tools lets them float).
